description: A camper van faces right with a long rounded roof, a sloping front, and two circular wheels. A side window and a broad front windscreen sit above the plain lower body.
A seated person paddles a canoe facing right, holding a long paddle diagonally upward. The canoe has a level gunwale and a raised curved bow above a row of waves.
A narrow kayak is viewed from above, with pointed ends and an oval cockpit at its centre. A double-bladed paddle crosses behind it diagonally from lower left to upper right.
A person raises a long-handled net overhead toward a butterfly on the left. The net has an oval opening and a tapering bag, while the figure is shown from the torso up.
A broad rectangular diving weight has softly rounded corners and two tall, narrow slots side by side. The parallel openings run vertically through the otherwise plain face of the block.
A diver swims horizontally toward the right beneath a row of surface waves, with a tank on the back. The legs bend upward behind the body, and an arm reaches forward.
A low floating buoy supports a tall mast with a swallowtail diving flag. A diagonal stripe crosses the flag, and the mast descends into a pointed support above the broad curved float.
Two upright air cylinders stand side by side, each with a domed top and a horizontal shoulder band. A curved hose above them connects a large circular fitting to a smaller hanging regulator.

description: A partly visible diver reaches toward a vertical buoy line beneath the water surface. A circular float and small rectangular flag sit on the line between two short wave crests.
A vertical buoy line carries a circular float at the water surface and a small rectangular flag above it. Two short wave crests flank the float, while the line extends downward.
A person shown from the chest up extends a bent arm toward an upright bottle on the right. The bottle has a broad body, sloping shoulders, a long neck, and a small cap.
A person shown from the chest up extends a bent arm toward a cocktail glass on the right. The glass has a triangular bowl, a short stem, and a circular garnish above it.
A front-facing person holds a small game controller centrally with both hands. The rounded arms curve inward around the controller, and two straight lines extend downward to indicate the lower body.
A person shown from the torso up aims a long gun diagonally toward the upper left. Both arms support the gun beneath a small flying bird with an upraised wing.
A riderless personal watercraft faces left above a row of waves. Its pointed bow rises toward a high handlebar, and a stepped seat extends along the low rear body.
A person leans forward from the right to look through a horizontal telescope. The tapered barrel rests on a three-legged tripod, and the person's bent arms reach toward its support.
A person leans back on the left while gripping a tall curved sail with both arms. Bent legs meet the wave line beneath a sail divided by a horizontal boom.
A long narrow sailboard tilts upward at the right above a row of waves. A leaning mast supports a curved triangular sail with two parallel diagonal lines across its lower portion.
A riderless jet ski faces right, with a tall curved front cowling and a low rear seat. A short handlebar rises behind the cowling above two rows of waves.
A person crouches with bent knees on a surfboard sloping down toward the right. The arms extend in opposite directions for balance, and the board's left end curls upward.
A front-facing person stands beside a tall upright surfboard on the right. The board has a pointed nose, a narrow flattened tail, and a diagonal stripe across its middle.
A person leans backward with bent knees at the water surface, extending both arms toward a horizontal tow line running right. A row of waves crosses the feet and lower legs.
A palm tree curves upward on the left beneath a spreading crown of broad pointed fronds. A sagging hammock extends right from its trunk, with its far end rising to a point.
A horse stands in profile facing right with pointed ears, a long muzzle, and a hanging tail. An upright rider sits astride its back, with one arm reaching toward the neck.
A tilted diamond-shaped kite has two crossing spars joining its opposite corners. Two loose curved tails trail below it, one curling toward the lower left and the other descending centrally.
A small sailboat has a rounded hull and a vertical mast carrying one straight-edged triangular sail to the left. Two rows of waves pass beneath and across the lower hull.
A small sailboat has a broad hull beneath a central mast and two sails. The left sail is narrow and pointed, while the right sail curves outward above the waves.

concept: Jet Ski Rider Jumping a Wave
description: A person crouches over the handlebars of a jet ski angled across a curling wave. The pointed bow faces left, and the rider's rear leg extends outward behind the body.

concept: Jet Ski Rider Jumping a Wave
description: A person leans forward over a jet ski facing left above a breaking wave. One leg bends against the craft while the other stretches back, echoing the upward motion of the bow.
A person sits astride a low jet ski facing left, leaning toward the handlebars. One bent leg hangs over the side of the rounded craft above a continuous wavy water line.
A seated person holds a double-bladed paddle diagonally across a long narrow kayak. The kayak is viewed from the side with pointed ends, while the lower paddle blade extends below it.
A person balances on a short board at the lower right, reaching toward a large crescent-shaped kite overhead to the left. A tether connects the hands to the kite's divided canopy.
A person balances on a slackline with both arms spread and one knee raised. The supporting leg meets the low centre of the line, which rises gently toward both ends.
A person stands with bent knees on an oval wakeboard, leaning back while holding a triangular tow handle to the left. A straight tow line continues left from the handle.
A person stands on the right side of a long sailboard, reaching toward a tall curved sail. The sail narrows to a high point on the right above a row of waves.
A person bends the knees on a long sloping board and reaches left toward a tall sail outline. The sail curves to a pointed top, but its right edge is visibly incomplete.
A person reclines with bent knees and an arm supporting the body above a wavy water line. A circular sun with short rays appears high on the right of the scene.
A person reclines on a sloping sun lounger with bent knees and feet toward the right. A round sun with short rays sits overhead beside the chair's raised back.
A person balances with spread arms and bent knees on a sloping surfboard. A tall wave curls behind the rider on the right, above a separate line of smaller waves.
A person reclines in a deep freestanding bathtub with bent arms visible above its rim. The tub has rounded lower corners and two short feet, with three wavy steam trails overhead.
